scope: Existing Aave preauthorized financial position-manager transitions, not approval installation

additions.label: Aave V3 preauthorized setUserEModeOnBehalfOf
warnings: Static exact deployment/interface/source metadata, not an API-key grant or a live configuration, runtime identity, financial-safety, balance, liquidity or execution assurance. Independent grants, pauses, canonical ABI/value checks and final acceptance remain mandatory.

Only consumes an existing Aave position-manager approval for onBehalfOf. onlyPositionManager requires _positionManager[onBehalfOf][msg.sender] even for self use; this function neither installs nor revokes approval. approvePositionManager and renouncePositionManagerRole remain excluded. Most unapproved callers will revert.

The fixed SupplyLogic transition changes the named existing user financial collateral flag or eMode category and applies protocol reserve, category, oracle, debt and health validation. All ABI-valid assets, booleans and uint8 categories remain caller-selected; configuration, eligibility, liquidation exposure and financial outcomes are not assured. No caller-selected executable target, calldata or callback is accepted.

Nonpayable: zero native value. Existing per-proxy implementation ABI bindings are retained independently; the pinned official Pool.sol supplies the reviewed financial/authorization bodies, not a fresh bytecode or approval-state attestation.
